test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The efforts of the doctors came to a __futile__ end with the death of the patient.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Fruitless**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Futile**' is '**Fruitless**'.
 
• **Futile**: producing no result, unsuccessful, or incapable of producing any useful result. It refers to something that is pointless, fruitless or useless. (कोई परिणाम न देने वाला, असफल, या कोई उपयोगी परिणाम उत्पन्न करने में असमर्थ। यह किसी ऐसी चीज को संदर्भित करता है जो व्यर्थ, फलहीन या बेकार है)
 
 
• *Example: Attempts to get supplies to the region are **futile** because troops will not allow the aid convoy to enter the city.*
 
 
 
• **Fruitless**: producing poor or no results; not successful. (अपर्याप्त अथवा शून्‍य परिणाम देने वाला, निष्‍फल; विफल, असफल)
 
 
• *Example: a **fruitless** search...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Fruitless.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Enriching**: improving or enhancing someone's knowledge, experience, or understanding. (किसी के ज्ञान, अनुभव या समझ को सुधारना या बढ़ाना)
 
• **Startling**: causing surprise, alarm, or a feeling of being taken aback. (आश्चर्य, अलार्म, या अचंभित होने की भावना पैदा करना)
 
• **Terrifying**: causing extreme fear or alarm. (अत्यधिक भय पैदा करना)
